sql: select v.version, g.gate_key, g.spec_json::text as spec, r.verdict, r.sample_json::text as sample, r.metrics_json::text as metrics, r.computed_at::text as computed from experiment_versions v join experiment_gates g on g.version_id=v.id left join experiment_gate_results r on r.gate_id=g.id and r.id=(select max(id) from experiment_gate_results r2 where r2.gate_id=g.id) where v.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and g.gate_key='paper_to_live_canary' order by v.version desc limit 3
